row.team_price_text: Pro: contact-based price set by script (3 team members)
row.evidence: Mailmodo's pricing page lists only team-member counts per plan (1, 3, 5) with no SSO or SCIM line, and its help centre adds team members by email invite under Settings → Team Members; no SCIM endpoint or SSO is documented.
row.notes: New in September 2026. No SCIM and no SAML/OIDC SSO on any plan; the only account-security feature documented is 2FA. Pricing is contact-based and the plan prices are filled in by script from the contact slider: a headless render on 2026-10-05 showed Lite $27 and Pro $79 per month billed annually at 500 contacts, but the page then blocked the renderer and the static HTML holds hidden placeholder values ($149/$199), so no price is recorded; Max is custom. Lite allows only 1 team member, so Pro is the team plan. Team members are invited manually with Full or Limited access. The REST API covers campaigns, contacts and journeys, not team members. No Okta OIN or Entra gallery app found.

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: 1 team member, so it is not the team plan. Price not recorded (see row notes).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented on the pricing page, help centre (sitemap of 580 URLs, Login and Authentication and User Management categories) or the Stoplight API reference; 'false' is by absence (rule 5), not an explicit vendor statement.

user_api.notes: The public REST API (API key) covers campaigns, contacts, lists, journeys, templates and events only; the Stoplight reference has no team-member, role or audit-log endpoints. Team members are managed only in Settings → Team Members.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/mailmodo/ returns 404; no Mailmodo app found.

fallbacks.notes: Help centre and API reference are public. CSV import exists for contacts (marketing audience), not for team members.
